commitResults.messageBody:
Alzara.java mixed command-handling logic with direct System.out/Scanner
calls in every switch case, making it hard to see the control flow and
impossible to reuse or swap the interaction layer independently.

Move all printing and input-reading into a new Ui class with named
methods (showWelcome, showTaskAdded, showError, readCommand, etc.).
Alzara.java now only orchestrates commands and talks to the user
through Ui, matching the target design's separation of concerns.

No behavioural change: the "task added" messages for todo/deadline/
event share one showTaskAdded(flavourText, task, taskCount) method
since they follow an identical shape, avoiding three near-duplicate
methods. Verified via the full UI regression suite (test-ui skill) -
all 9 test cases pass unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract TaskList class to encapsulate the task list
commitResults.messageBody:
Alzara.java held the task list as a raw ArrayList<Task> that
every command case reached into directly.

Add a TaskList class wrapping the ArrayList and exposing add, get,
delete, and size as named operations. Storage.save and Ui.showTaskList still take a plain ArrayList<Task>, so TaskList exposes getTasks() for those two call sites

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract CommandParser class to parse command arguments
commitResults.messageBody:
Add a CommandParser class with parseTodo, parseDeadline, parseEvent,
and parseTaskIndex, each turning a raw command string into a Task (or
index) and throwing AlzaraException when the input is malformed.
Alzara.java's switch cases shrink to a few lines each that just call
the matching parse method and act on the result

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Alzara an instantiable object with a run() method
Introduce a Command hierarchy for every user command
commitResults.messageBody:
Alzara's switch statement mixed checking the command with executing it in
every case.

Add an abstract Command class and one concrete
subclass per case: ExitCommand, AddCommand, MarkCommand, UnmarkCommand, DeleteCommand, ListCommand, and UnknownCommand

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command dispatch into CommandParser
Merge branch 'branch-A-MoreOOP' Refactored code handled in Alzara.java into separate classes
Reject unrecognised commands instead of saving them as raw tasks
commitResults.messageBody:
Unrecognised input was added to the task list as a raw Task via
UnknownCommand but never included a type letter (T/D/E), so
Storage.loadTask() could never parse them back, displaying an error
each time the tasks were loaded.

Remove the ability to add a task without a real command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for TaskList and Task's subclasses
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList is the one piece of state every command touches, and ToDo/
Deadline/Event carry both the shared done-state behaviour inherited
